verdict.rationale: Missive ships a built-in AI assistant (Copilot) that runs long sessions with a tab showing what it is doing, and it creates drafts on the user's behalf. It also answers feature questions from the docs, composes, replies and translates, and can call connected MCP tools such as Notion, Linear, Attio or custom servers, so users can delegate real tasks inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality, clear documentation of the full range of actions the assistant can take, and it only runs on the user's own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API key.
